svg.title: Proto shield wiring (2026-10-20)
svg.desc: Arduino proto shield v.5 for the autonomous car: suggested placement of the TB6612 carrier, caps, divider, strip resistors, pads and connectors (left, landmarks read off Evan's photo) and every net on the shield (right), with the meter checks to do before power. Source: docs/WIRING_PROTOSHIELD.md section 2.
svg.text: Proto shield (v.5) - what goes where, and every connection on it (2026-10-20)
Left: the board as in your photo (USB end of the Uno on the LEFT, digital headers at the top). Shaded boxes = suggested spots. Board landmarks are read off the photo - approximate.
Right: every net. Wire numbers W9-W17 match docs/pack_wiring_full.svg. Lines that cross WITHOUT a dot are not connected. All wire 22 AWG.
SUPERSEDED for placement (2026-10-20): use docs/shield_holemap.svg + docs/SHIELD_BUILD.md. Since then: STAR = the printed rail B; C3 470 uF moved onto each strip's input pads.
PROTO SHIELD v.5 - top view (68.6 x 53.3 mm); digital I/O pins used are in red
<- USB end (Uno USB-B: faces the car's -y side)
On the car the USB end faces the car's -y side (the USB-B plug), so the digital-header edge faces the deck's REAR and the
power/analog edge faces the Pi. The pack wires (W9, W12, W13, W14), motor/encoder and servo arrive from the front: put the
connectors where their leads have the shortest run. The zones are suggestions - any free strip works if the nets match.
VM to GND, at the carrier
every ground lands here on its OWN wire:
W15 jumper from the printed GND bus
cap on the LEFT pair = servo on
W15: ONE jumper, printed GND bus -> STAR (the Uno's ground joins the star at one point)
METER CHECKS - Uno OFF the shield, nothing plugged in, continuity (beep) mode
proves the 5V bus IS the Uno's 5V (Pi USB) - so nothing from the pack may touch it
if it beeps, the LM2596 and the Pi's USB 5 V would fight on the Uno 5V pin - find the bridge first
VBAT pad <-> STAR, and VBAT pad <-> 5V bus
a beep is a short across the pack or onto the Uno
Vin stays empty - VBAT on Vin would run the Uno's regulator off the pack
the Uno's ground joins the star at ONE point
C1 charging can chirp briefly; a steady beep is a short
- TB6612FNG carrier, Pololu #713, on 0.1 in headers (not flying leads)
- C1 470-1000 uF electrolytic (mind + / -) and C2 0.1 uF ceramic, VM to GND, right at the carrier
- C3 470 uF across +5V2 / GND at the strip feed point
- R1-R4: 4 x 200 ohm - two in series in each strip's DIN line (400 ohm each)
- J1 6-pin (motor + encoder), J2 3-pin (servo), JP1 3-pin + jumper cap, J3 / J4 3-pin (strips), J5 4-pin (power in): screw terminals or JST
- OFF the shield: the LM2596 and the rocker (deck -y wing), the 0.1 uF across the motor (at the motor)
